name: LocalWave: Music from Files
subtitle: MP3, FLAC, albums & playlists
description:
Play the music files you already own. Choose folders in Files or iCloud Drive, import songs, and browse your library by artist, album or track.

LocalWave supports MP3, FLAC and other audio formats supported by the system. Native FLAC imports include tags and embedded artwork. Mark favorite tracks, build playlists, search your library, and use the playback queue, shuffle and repeat controls.

Music from your files. No Apple Music subscription is required. Use your iPhone’s volume buttons or Control Center to adjust listening volume.

Files stored in iCloud Drive or another provider may need downloading before playback. LocalWave does not provide a streaming music catalog or download music from third-party services.
publicationStatus: Version 1.0 (build 1) uploaded; owner confirmed internal TestFlight available. No App Store Review or Beta App Review is authorized.
